description: M10 provisional fault-matrix baseline (F01-F17).  Action-off; final reconciliation in Step 18A.

scenarios.label: effect-intent-persistence-failure
scenarios.expected_assertion: no provider call when intent is not durable
scenarios.note: Intent failure before dispatch must produce zero provider calls. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: effect-fulfillment-persistence-failure
scenarios.expected_assertion: provider call succeeded but ledger update failed -> indeterminated
scenarios.note: Post-apply crash produces indeterminate, not false success. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: provider-lost-ack
scenarios.expected_assertion: provider applied but ack lost -> query confirms, no redispatch
scenarios.note: Lost ACK resolved via provider query; retry must not double-apply. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: provider-query-failure
scenarios.expected_assertion: provider unreachable for query -> indeterminate, no blind retry
scenarios.note: Query failure after dispatch must not authorize blind retry. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: duplicate-idempotency-key-conflict
scenarios.expected_assertion: divergent duplicate raises conflict, not silent overwrite
scenarios.note: Duplicate idempotency key with different payload must quarantine. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: terminal-state-transition-guard
scenarios.note: Cannot transition from indeterminate to fulfilled. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: lease-expiry-during-effect
scenarios.note: Lease expiry must fence the provider call. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: lease-ttl-ceiling-enforcement
scenarios.note: Max TTL ceiling enforced on lease acquisition and renew. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: repair-recurrence-minimum-interval
scenarios.expected_assertion: same-signature recurrence within minimum interval is suppressed
scenarios.note: Recurrence floor prevents repair-loop thrashing. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: unknown-effect-class-escalation
scenarios.expected_assertion: unknown effect class produces action-off with typed escalation
scenarios.note: Unknown effect classes remain action-off. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: non-queryable-effect-class-action-off
scenarios.note: Non-queryable effects cannot be reconciled; must remain action-off. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: non-idempotent-effect-class-action-off
scenarios.expected_assertion: non-idempotent ambiguous class cannot be safely retried
scenarios.note: Non-idempotent effects cannot be safely retried. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: custody-epoch-staleness-rejection
scenarios.expected_assertion: stale custody epoch prevents effect dispatch
scenarios.note: Stale epoch must fence before provider call. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: run-authority-fence-rejection
scenarios.expected_assertion: missing or stale Run Authority grant prevents dispatch
scenarios.note: Run Authority must be current at dispatch time. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: wbc-evidence-missing-rejection
scenarios.expected_assertion: missing WBC attempt evidence prevents dispatch
scenarios.note: WBC evidence (not projection) must authorize dispatch. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: first-terminal-folding
scenarios.expected_assertion: first terminal state preserved when duplicate terminal events appear
scenarios.note: Journal fold preserves first terminal state. M10 action-off.

scenarios.label: subjective-only-criteria-rejection
scenarios.expected_assertion: subjective-only must criteria are rejected before dispatch
scenarios.note: Criteria verifiability gate blocks subjective-only acceptance criteria. M10 action-off.

reconciliation.note: Each F01-F16 scenario references bc:execute_approval; F17 references bc:gate_to_revise. Join enforced by validate_inventory_coverage.
